authority: #K2-425 sec.4.3: the sec.16.3 four-element plan for the block-contention capability.
element1_death_cause: the block's nets each re-solve independently, so they COMPETE for the same space; the winner is decided by routing order, not by need (measured: C1 stays 5 whatever the corridors look like).
element2_proven_facts: R1224 (authorised N=1): C1=5, C2 clean, nine rows; identical to the no-yield baseline
R1222: planning-layer corridors are 5/5 conservation-PASS yet the board still shows C1=5 => the residual is BLOCK-level contention
R1208: the per-row blockers are named (MCU_VDD/NRST/P3V3_AUX/GND/I2C1_SCL)

element3_corrected_plan.principle: ONE coordinated deterministic allocation: assign each block net a disjoint channel FIRST (order by a fixed rule), then route inside it - no competition.
element3_corrected_plan.determinism: order-preserving disjoint channel assignment (no search); one pass
element3_corrected_plan.conservation: per-channel (NOT block-level): each channel's own clear width vs its net's need
